cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.15)
include(GNUInstallDirs)

# ── Guard: NSX board flags must be defined ────────────────────────────────
if(NOT DEFINED NSX_BOARD_FLAGS_TARGET)
    message(FATAL_ERROR
        "hkv_denoise_aot: NSX_BOARD_FLAGS_TARGET is not defined.\n"
        "This module requires the NSX build system. Use --module.type=cmake for standalone builds.")
endif()

# ── Static library (shared boilerplate from macros.j2) ────────────────────
add_library(hkv_denoise_aot STATIC)

target_compile_features(hkv_denoise_aot PUBLIC c_std_99)

  $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/includes-api>
  $<INSTALL_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR}/nsx/modules/hkv_denoise_aot/includes-api>
)

# ── NSX alias / export name ───────────────────────────────────────────────
set_target_properties(hkv_denoise_aot PROPERTIES EXPORT_NAME hkv_denoise_aot)
add_library(nsx::hkv_denoise_aot ALIAS hkv_denoise_aot)

# ── Dependencies ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
target_link_libraries(hkv_denoise_aot
    PUBLIC
        ${NSX_BOARD_FLAGS_TARGET}
        nsx::cmsis_nn
)

# ── CMSIS-NN float kernels (REQUIRED for this module) ──────────────────────
#
# This module dispatches to ns-cmsis-nn float entry points
# (arm_*_f32). Those kernel objects only exist when
# ns-cmsis-nn itself was configured with the matching switch, typically by
# setting `ARM_NN_ENABLE_F32=ON` in the NSX top-level CMake
# cache BEFORE `nsx::cmsis_nn` is added.
#
# The library answers for itself through ns_cmsis_nn_float_support(), which
# reports what the ns-cmsis-nn in scope was actually built with on every
# delivery path, including the prebuilt `find_package(ns-cmsis-nn)` one where
# the cache variables stay empty. Releases without that query still publish
# the same decision as compile definitions on the kernel target, so the target
# is read directly instead. Both paths link the target and inherit its
# definitions, so nothing is force-defined there. NSX always supplies the
# kernel target the module links, so there is no bring-your-own-kernel path on
# this backend. Configure fails fast when the library lacks a float type this
# module needs, so the problem surfaces as a clear error instead of a confusing
# linker error later.
set(_helia_nn_target "")
if(TARGET nsx::cmsis_nn)
    set(_helia_nn_target nsx::cmsis_nn)
endif()

if(COMMAND ns_cmsis_nn_float_support AND _helia_nn_target)
    # Naming the target skips the query's own discovery, which refuses to
    # answer when several ns-cmsis-nn targets are in scope at once.
    ns_cmsis_nn_float_support(F32 _helia_nn_f32 F16 _helia_nn_f16 TARGET ${_helia_nn_target})
elseif(_helia_nn_target)
    get_target_property(_helia_nn_defs ${_helia_nn_target} INTERFACE_COMPILE_DEFINITIONS)
    if(NOT _helia_nn_defs)
        set(_helia_nn_defs "")
    endif()
    # An INTERFACE library has no COMPILE_DEFINITIONS and asking for it is an
    # error, so a source build's own definitions are only read off a real
    # target.
    get_target_property(_helia_nn_type ${_helia_nn_target} TYPE)
    if(NOT _helia_nn_type STREQUAL "INTERFACE_LIBRARY")
        get_target_property(_helia_nn_own_defs ${_helia_nn_target} COMPILE_DEFINITIONS)
        if(_helia_nn_own_defs)
            list(APPEND _helia_nn_defs ${_helia_nn_own_defs})
        endif()
    endif()
    set(_helia_nn_f32 OFF)
    if("ARM_NN_ENABLE_F32" IN_LIST _helia_nn_defs OR "ARM_NN_ENABLE_F32=1" IN_LIST _helia_nn_defs)
        set(_helia_nn_f32 ON)
    endif()
endif()

if(NOT _helia_nn_f32)
    message(FATAL_ERROR
        "hkv_denoise_aot: requires ns-cmsis-nn built with ARM_NN_ENABLE_F32=ON, "
        "but the ns-cmsis-nn it links was built without it. Set "
        "`ARM_NN_ENABLE_F32=ON` (e.g. via `-DARM_NN_ENABLE_F32=ON` or a "
        "top-level `set(... CACHE BOOL \"\" FORCE)`) before configuring NSX.")
endif()

# ── Memory placement override hook ────────────────────────────────────────
# Consumers (e.g. heliaPROFILER) can set this to a header that redefines
# the HKV_DENOISE_PUT_IN_* macros with real section attributes.
# The header is force-preincluded so it takes effect before platform.h's
# #ifndef guards.
if(DEFINED HKV_DENOISE_AOT_ATTRIBUTES_HEADER)
    if(EXISTS "${HKV_DENOISE_AOT_ATTRIBUTES_HEADER}")
        target_compile_options(hkv_denoise_aot PUBLIC
            "-include${HKV_DENOISE_AOT_ATTRIBUTES_HEADER}"
        )
    else()
        message(WARNING
            "hkv_denoise_aot: attributes header not found: "
            "${HKV_DENOISE_AOT_ATTRIBUTES_HEADER}")
    endif()
endif()

# ── Install ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
install(DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/includes-api
    DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR}/nsx/modules/hkv_denoise_aot)
install(TARGETS hkv_denoise_aot EXPORT nsxTargets)
